verdict: WMI errors detected. The repository or a provider is misbehaving. Many MECM client functions depend on WMI, so one bad namespace cascades into multiple visible failures.
fix: Check repository consistency: `winmgmt /verifyrepository`. If inconsistent, `winmgmt /salvagerepository` first. Use `/resetrepository` only as a last resort (destroys the CCM namespace; follow with `ccmsetup.exe /forceinstall`). Before a reset, capture the WMI-Activity operational event log so the specific failing provider is preserved for later root-cause review.
